shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright stone slab/monolith
repeated symbolic signs arranged in registers
justification: Both are upright stone monuments bearing shallow relief signs and motifs organised in horizontal bands, including disc-like circular forms, but that is a generic correspondence. A shows a narrative lunette scene of standing figures flanking and worshipping beneath a rayed disc above dense rows of script signs, whereas B is a three-dimensional block-like anthropomorphic figure whose body surface carries a few isolated curvilinear emblems (rings, arcs, band across the waist) with no figural scene or text rows.
